title: "Why ‘Christian’ Does Not Always Mean Saved – The Danger of False Converts" 🔥
paragraphs:
"Why ‘Christian’ Does Not Always Mean Saved – The Danger of False Converts" 🔥
✝️ A Message from Brother John Domino "PiX" S. Asis – Follower of Jesus Christ and a Servant of God
🌍 A hard truth: Not everyone who calls themselves a ‘Christian’ is truly saved.

Just because someone attends church doesn’t mean they belong to Christ.
Just because someone prays doesn’t mean they have a relationship with God.
Just because someone knows Bible verses doesn’t mean their heart is transformed.
💡 Being a Christian is not about a label—it’s about a transformed life through Jesus Christ.
📖 “Not everyone who says to Me, ‘Lord, Lord,’ will enter the kingdom of heaven, but only the one who does the will of My Father who is in heaven.” (Matthew 7:21)

🔥 The Problem: Cultural Christianity vs. True Christianity
In today’s world, many claim the name of Christ but deny Him with their lives.
What is Cultural Christianity?

Believing in God, but living like He doesn’t exist.
Saying “I’m a Christian” because of family tradition, not personal faith.
Attending church but having no personal relationship with Jesus.
📖 “They honor Me with their lips, but their hearts are far from Me.” (Matthew 15:8)
Cultural Christianity is dangerous because it gives people a false sense of security—thinking they’re saved when they’re not.

🔥 The Warning: Jesus Said Many Will Be Shocked on Judgment Day
Imagine standing before Jesus, thinking you're saved… only to hear Him say:
📖 “I never knew you. Depart from Me, you workers of lawlessness.” (Matthew 7:23)
Jesus isn’t looking for religious activity—He’s looking for a heart surrendered to Him.
🚨 The scariest part? Many will think they are saved, but Jesus will reject them.

🔥 What Does TRUE Salvation Look Like?
1️⃣ A Personal Relationship with Jesus, Not Just Religion
Christianity isn’t just about going to church—it’s about knowing Christ personally.
📖 “This is eternal life: that they know You, the only true God, and Jesus Christ, whom You have sent.” (John 17:3)

2️⃣ A Changed Heart, Not Just Empty Words
Many say they love Jesus, but their actions deny Him.
📖 “If anyone is in Christ, he is a new creation; the old has passed away, the new has come.” (2 Corinthians 5:17)

3️⃣ True Faith in Jesus ALONE, Not Good Works
Salvation is by grace alone, through faith alone, in Christ alone—not by being “good.”
📖 “I am the way, the truth, and the life. No one comes to the Father except through Me.” (John 14:6)

🔥 Signs of a False Convert vs. A True Christian
⚠️ A false convert says "I believe in Jesus" but continues to live in unrepentant sin.
✔️ A true Christian turns from sin and seeks to follow Christ.

⚠️ A false convert relies on good works to be saved.
✔️ A true Christian trusts in Jesus alone for salvation.

⚠️ A false convert goes to church for tradition, not transformation.
✔️ A true Christian lives daily for Jesus with genuine faith.

⚠️ A false convert ignores the Bible and prays only in emergencies.
✔️ A true Christian loves the Word of God and seeks His will.

⚠️ A false convert thinks everyone is "going to heaven" because they’re "good."
✔️ A true Christian knows that only those in Christ are saved.

🔥 How to Know If You’re Truly Saved
❌ Being “religious” won’t save you.
❌ Trying to be a “good person” won’t save you.
❌ Having Christian parents won’t save you.
✅ Only faith in Jesus Christ can save you.
📖 “Believe in the Lord Jesus, and you will be saved.” (Acts 16:31)

🔥 What Must You Do to Be Sure You’re Truly Saved?
1️⃣ Examine Your Heart.
Ask yourself: “Do I truly know Jesus, or do I just know about Him?”

2️⃣ Repent and Believe in Jesus Christ Alone.
📖 “If you confess with your mouth, ‘Jesus is Lord,’ and believe in your heart that God raised Him from the dead, you will be saved.” (Romans 10:9)

3️⃣ Seek a Relationship, Not Just Religion.
📖 “Draw near to God, and He will draw near to you.” (James 4:8)

4️⃣ Follow Jesus Daily.
Read His Word, obey His teachings, and grow in faith.
📖 “Whoever wants to be My disciple must deny themselves and take up their cross daily and follow Me.” (Luke 9:23)

📜 FAITH DECLARATION FOR JANUARY 16, 2025 📜
"Today, I reject cultural Christianity. I don’t just want the name ‘Christian’—I want to truly follow Jesus. I surrender my heart fully to Him and place my faith in Christ alone for salvation."

🔥 THE “TRUE CHRISTIAN” CHALLENGE 🔥
✅ Step 1: Examine your heart—are you truly saved, or just religious?
✅ Step 2: If you’re truly saved, share your testimony today.
✅ Step 3: Tag 3 friends and challenge them to evaluate their faith.

🌌 DON'T JUST CALL YOURSELF A CHRISTIAN – BE ONE 🌌
📖 “Be doers of the word, and not hearers only, deceiving yourselves.” (James 1:22)

👉 It’s time to stop playing church and start following Jesus for real.
👉 Eternity is too long to be wrong. Make sure your faith is real today.

🙏 PRAYER FOR JANUARY 16, 2025 🙏
Heavenly Father,
Thank You for showing me that salvation is not about a title but a true relationship with Jesus Christ. I repent from trusting in my own goodness or traditions, and today, I put my full faith in Jesus alone. Help me to live as a true follower, walking in obedience and love for You.
In Jesus’ name, Amen. ✝️
